test_prompts.prompt: Store a new memory: 'My favorite database for vector search is pgvector with ivfflat index. I tested it last week and got 50ms query times.'
test_prompts.expected: Node created with content, metadata (timestamp, source=session), extracted topic='database/vector-search', no contradictions flagged since this is first mention

test_prompts.prompt: Store another memory: 'I switched to hnsw index on pgvector and now queries take 10ms. ivfflat was too slow for my dataset.'
test_prompts.expected: New node created. Contradiction detected with previous node (ivfflat 50ms vs hnsw 10ms). Both nodes marked with contradiction edge. User profile updated: preference for hnsw over ivfflat.

test_prompts.prompt: Search: 'what database index should I use for vector search?'
test_prompts.expected: Returns both nodes (ivfflat and hnsw), with contradiction highlighted. Ranks hnsw higher because it's the more recent statement and user profile shows preference for it.

test_prompts.prompt: After 90 days, query: 'what database index should I use?' with automatic forgetting enabled (default 60-day expiry for preference nodes)
test_prompts.expected: The ivfflat node is marked superseded/forgotten. Only hnsw node returned. User profile still shows hnsw preference (profile facts have longer expiry than raw memories).
